defaults.DESCRIPTION: Welcome to my Rimworld Together server!

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server. Maximum 40 characters

configurationFields.label: Serverbeschreibung
configurationFields.description: Sets the description of the server. Maximum 200 characters
configurationFields.default: Welcome to my Rimworld Together server!
configurationFields.placeholder: Welcome to my Rimworld Together server!

configurationFields.label: Show In Server Browser
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be visible in the public server browser

configurationFields.label: Public Endpoint Address Selection Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether and how the public endpoint address (IP or domain) for the server, as used by the server browser, is set. If 'Address manually set' is selected, specify the desired public endpoint address under Manual Public Endpoint Address

options: IP automatically set by Rimworld Together (default)

configurationFields.label: Manual Public Endpoint Address
configurationFields.description: Sets the public endpoint address (IP or domain) for the server, if 'Address manually set' is selected as the Public Endpoint Address Selection Mode

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Enable Whitelist
configurationFields.description: If set, allows only the usernames listed under Whitelisted Players to join the server

configurationFields.label: Whitelisted Players
configurationFields.description: Sets a list of in-game usernames for whitelisted players. Requires Enable Whitelist to be set

configurationFields.label: Enable Verbose Logging
configurationFields.description: If set, the server console will include additional logging output for developer or debugging purposes. Not recommended for normal use

configurationFields.label: Enable Extreme Verbose Logging
configurationFields.description: If set, the server console will include much more verbose logging

configurationFields.label: Display Chat In Console
configurationFields.description: If set, player chat will be displayed in the server console

configurationFields.label: Use UPnP
configurationFields.description: If set, UPnP will be used to automatically configure port forwarding on compatible routers

configurationFields.label: Sync Local Save
configurationFields.description: If set, local save syncing will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Temporal Activity Protection
configurationFields.description: If set, temporal activity protection will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Temporal Activity Protection Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the cooldown between receiving activity requests. Temporal Activity Protection must be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Temporal Event Protection
configurationFields.description: If set, temporal event protection will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Temporal Event Protection Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the cooldown between receiving player-sent events. Temporal Event Protection must be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Temporal Aid Protection
configurationFields.description: If set, temporal aid protection will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Temporal Aid Protection Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the cooldown between receiving player-sent aid. Temporal Aid Protection must be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Temporal Spy Protection
configurationFields.description: If set, temporal spy protection will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Temporal Spy Protection Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the cooldown between spying attempts. Temporal Spy Protection must be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Server MOTD
configurationFields.description: If enabled, sends a welcome message to all players that log in

configurationFields.label: Server MOTD
configurationFields.description: Sets message sent to players when they log in. Enable Server MOTD must be set

configurationFields.label: Login Notifications
configurationFields.description: If enabled, sends a message when a user logs in

configurationFields.label: Disconnect Notifications
configurationFields.description: If enabled, sends a message when a user logs off

configurationFields.label: Enable Automatic Backups
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will automatically create backups at regular intervals

configurationFields.label: Backup Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval between automatic backups. A backup is also created when the server is started

configurationFields.label: Enable Automatic Backup Deletion
configurationFields.description: If enabled, old backups will be automatically deleted, based on the Backup Retention Amount

configurationFields.label: Backup Retention Amount
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of backups to keep before older backups are deleted, if Automatic Backup Deletion is enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Offline Activities
configurationFields.description: If set, offline visting and raiding will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Events
configurationFields.description: If set, events will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Sites
configurationFields.description: If set, creation of sites will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Roads
configurationFields.description: If set, creation of user-built roads will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Factions
configurationFields.description: If set, creation of user-made factions will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Aids
configurationFields.description: If set, transfer of pawns will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Trading
configurationFields.description: If set, transfer of items will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Spying
configurationFields.description: If set, spying on offline will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Custom Scenarios
configurationFields.description: If set, selection by users of custom scenarios will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Enable NPC Destruction
configurationFields.description: If set, permanent destruction of NPC settlements by users will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Enable Pollution Spread
configurationFields.description: If set, users with Biotech will be allowed to spread pollution to world tiles, including other players

configurationFields.label: Enforced Game Speed
configurationFields.description: Sets the game speed the server will be running at. 0 = no restriction

configurationFields.label: Spy Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of spying on a player

configurationFields.label: Allow Dirt Path
configurationFields.description: If set, user-built dirt paths will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Dirt Road
configurationFields.description: If set, user-built dirt roads will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Stone Road
configurationFields.description: If set, user-built stone roads will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Asphalt Path
configurationFields.description: If set, user-built asphalt paths will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Asphalt Highway
configurationFields.description: If set, user-built asphalt highways will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Dirt Path Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of building a dirt path

configurationFields.label: Dirt Road Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of building a dirt road

configurationFields.label: Stone Road Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of building a stone road

configurationFields.label: Asphalt Path Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of building an asphalt path

configurationFields.label: Asphalt Highway Cost
configurationFields.description: Sets the cost of building an asphalt highway

configurationFields.label: Server Release Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [server release version](https://github.com/RimworldTogether/Rimworld-Together/releases) to install. Empty = latest. Minimum version 1.4.0. Note that GSCS's settings may not work with older versions. Update the server after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: Dotnet Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [ASP.NET Core Runtime 7.0 version](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/7.0) to install. Empty = latest. Update the server after changing this setting

deploymentSteps.name: ASP.NET Core Runtime Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $DotnetVersion='{DOTNETVERSION}'; Set-Location -Path '{SERVER_DIR}/'; if (Test-Path 'Dotnet/dotnet.exe') { $InstalledVersion = (& Dotnet/dotnet.exe --list-runtimes | Where-Object { $_ -like 'Microsoft.AspNetCore.App*' } | Select-Object -First 1).Split()[1] } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DotnetVersion) ) { $DotnetVersion=(Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/7.0/releases.json).\"latest-runtime\" }; if ($DotnetVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid ASP.NET Core Runtime version format specified\"; exit 1 } elseif ( $InstalledVersion -eq $DotnetVersion ) { Write-Output \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/Runtime/$DotnetVersion/aspnetcore-runtime-$DotnetVersion-win-x64.zip -OutFile dotnet.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not GSCS. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Remove-Item -Path 'Dotnet/*' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Expand-Archive -Path \"dotnet.zip\" -DestinationPath \"Dotnet\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; Write-Output \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion downloaded\" }"

deploymentSteps.source:
{
  "Name": "GSCS Rimworld Together Server",
  "Description": "Welcome to my Rimworld Together server!",
  "IP": "0.0.0.0",
  "Port": "25555",
  "MaxPlayers": "100",
  "VerboseLogs": false,
  "ExtremeVerboseLogs": false,
  "DisplayChatInConsole": false,
  "UseUPnP": false,
  "SyncLocalSave": true,
  "TemporalActivityProtection": false,
  "TemporalActivityProtectionTime": 3600,
  "TemporalEventProtection": true,
  "TemporalEventProtectionTime": 3600,
  "TemporalAidProtection": false,
  "TemporalAidProtectionTime": 3600,
  "TemporalSpyProtection": true,
  "TemporalSpyProtectionTime": 3600
}
